Clear bushes

Collect items

Move corpses

Clear grass

Remove tree stumps

Area limit: Clear bushes
Maximum selectable area for the Clear Bushes tool. Used ONLY when 'Use one limit for all tools' above is unticked.
Area limit: Collect items
Maximum selectable area for the Collect Items tool. Used ONLY when 'Use one limit for all tools' above is unticked.
Area limit: Move corpses
Maximum selectable area for the Move Corpses tool. Used ONLY when 'Use one limit for all tools' above is unticked.
Area limit: Clear grass
Maximum selectable area for the Clear Grass tool. Used ONLY when 'Use one limit for all tools' above is unticked.
Area selection limit (all tools)
Used by every tool ONLY when 'Use one limit for all tools' above is ticked. Ignored otherwise. Cannot exceed 40, the same cap the game's own zone-selection tools use.
Area limit: Remove tree stumps
Maximum selectable area for the Remove Tree Stumps tool. Used ONLY when 'Use one limit for all tools' above is unticked.
Area limit: Till soil
Maximum selectable area for the Till Soil tool. Used ONLY when 'Use one limit for all tools' above is unticked.
Area limit: Chop trees
Maximum selectable area for the Chop Trees tool. Used ONLY when 'Use one limit for all tools' above is unticked.
Area limit: Saw logs into planks
Maximum selectable area for the Saw Logs Into Planks tool. Used ONLY when 'Use one limit for all tools' above is unticked.
Use one limit for all tools

Ticked: every tool uses the 'Area selection limit (all tools)' value below, the per-tool limits further down are ignored. Unticked: that value is ignored instead, and each tool uses its own limit below.
